svg.title: Data flow diagram
svg.desc: Your devices on the left, Fenn's servers in the middle, outside services on the right. Each arrow carries one of four labels: Encrypted on your device, Encrypted on Fenn's servers, Readable on Fenn's servers while in use, or Readable by Fenn's staff.
